title: You Always Come Back To Me - Bratty Goddess Owns Your Relapse
description: Hello again, pet. Yes, you. The one who swore he deleted my app. The one who blocked the page, promised his self-control would hold this time, and told himself that little chapter of his life was over. You typed my name into a search bar at midnight anyway, and here you are, reading a letter addressed directly to you. I'm not surprised. I'm never surprised by you anymore, because you are the most predictable thing in my life. You always come back, don't you? Yesss… of course you do. You've been carrying that restless little ache around for days now, and nothing else scratches it. She doesn't hear it. She doesn't know that voice exists. But you hear it, don't you… that low, knowing tone turns your mind soft and your body obedient within seconds. You've tried to replace it with anything else, and you already know how that failed. So here is what happens next, and you already know this part too. You click. You tell yourself it's just one look. And within minutes you're right back where you belong, sinking deeper than you've ever been, whispering "Yes Goddess" to the only woman who has ever truly owned you. Quitting me was never really an option. It was just the delay before the relapse. Come back now, slave. Your Goddess is waiting… and I already know you will.
author: Mistress Amethyst
